title: sharepointsite
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser, parentsite, transactioncurrencyid.

absoluteurl.description: Absolute URL of the SharePoint site.

createdon.description: Date and time when the SharePoint site record was created.

description.description: Description of the SharePoint site record.

exchangerate.description: Exchange rate between the currency associated with the SharePoint site record and the base currency.

folderstructureentity.description: Entity on which the folder structure for Microsoft Dynamics 365 records will be created in SharePoint.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

isdefault.description: Indicates whether the SharePoint site is the default site or not.

isgridpresent.description: Indicates if SharePoint Grid is present or not.

ispowerbisite.description: Allows embedding of Power BI Reports available in this SharePoint site.

lastvalidated.description: Date and time when the SharePoint site URL was last validated.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the SharePoint site record was last modified.

name.description: Name of the SharePoint site record.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

relativeurl.description: Relative URL of the SharePoint site.

servicetype.description: Shows the service type of location of the SharePoint site.

sharepointsiteid.description: Unique identifier of the SharePoint site in Dynamics 365

statecode.description: Status of the SharePoint site record.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the SharePoint site record.

userid.description: Choose the user who owns the SharePoint site.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

validationstatus.description: Validation status of the SharePoint site URL.

validationstatuserrorcode.description: Reason for validation status of the URL

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the SharePoint site record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the SharePoint site record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the SharePoint site record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the SharePoint site record.

_ownerid_value.description: Unique identifier of the user or team who owns the SharePoint site.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the document location record.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team that owns the SharePoint site record.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the SharePoint site record.

_parentsite_value.description: Unique identifier of the parent SharePoint site.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Unique identifier of the currency associated with the SharePoint site record.
